importantScopeFacts: Cloud SQL lifecycle REST permissions are project-level. Do not claim an instance-level IAM grant; isolated project plus signed exact-name/incarnation checks is the boundary.

Cloud Run job CREATE is checked on the parent location/project. Other workload job permissions can be constrained by a project IAM condition listing exact job resource names, subject to actual policy validation; operation GET needs project scope because provider LRO names are not known in advance.

Workflows roles reference lists Project as the lowest grant level. Scheduler gets only workflows.executions.create on the isolated project, which contains one approved workflow; its rendered URI is fixed. Do not claim a nonexistent exact-workflow grant.
GCS ledger CAS replacement requires objects.delete as well as objects.create. The object-name condition is separate from unconditional metadata get on the dedicated control bucket.

Cancellation permission is run.executions.cancel, per current cancellation guide (changed September 16, 2024). A stale REST cancel reference says run.jobs.run; do not grant watchdog execution authority to accommodate that stale text.
No runtime principal gets project/billing/IAM/network mutation, service-account keys, token creator, Cloud SQL data-plane administration, Firestore, ordinary serving, or restore privileges.
